answer: Payout is escrowed against a public bounty, not granted on submission. Anyone may post a counterexample the mechanism does not bind, and one accepted proof pays the challenger the escrow. Proof is non-rival: one counterexample voids every copy at once, so a thousand clones quoting one thread hang from a single knot. Scaling therefore means funding a thousand distinct designs, each surviving its own attack. That is research, which minting keys cannot parallelize. An honest author pays once for a claim nobody can pull apart; a fable retold is a target, and copied basalt falls on the copier.
